subs.name: Crawl and robots
subs.action: Take the {noindex_pages} out of the sitemap and recheck robots.txt after each release.

subs.name: Sitemap completeness, lastmod, hreflang
subs.action: List the {missing_pages} missing from sitemap.xml, or noindex them.

subs.name: Status codes, redirects, 404
subs.action: Fix broken internal links and error pages.

subs.name: Canonicals
subs.action: Point every page's canonical to its own address.

subs.name: Indexation (live)
subs.action: Request indexing in Search Console for the {unknown_pages} not in Google yet.

subs.name: Page speed proxy
subs.action: Trim the slowest pages first: {slowest}.

subs.name: Mobile, HTTPS, basics
subs.action: Set a mobile viewport on every page and force HTTPS.

subs.name: Titles
subs.action: Rewrite titles that are missing, duplicated or outside 25 to 65 characters.

subs.name: Meta descriptions
subs.action: Rewrite descriptions outside 70 to 160 characters.

subs.name: H1 and heading structure
subs.action: Use exactly one H1 per page.

subs.name: Query-intent match to target searches
subs.action: Give each target search one page and use its wording in the title and H1.

subs.name: Internal linking and anchors
subs.action: Link to weakly linked pages from related guides and service pages.

subs.name: Image alt and share images
subs.action: Add share images to the {noshare_pages} without one.

subs.name: Cluster coverage vs UAE F&B owner searches
subs.action: Write pages for target searches that have no matching page yet.

subs.name: Depth and accuracy
subs.action: Add worked UAE examples and figures to thin sections.

subs.name: Freshness, dated facts
subs.action: Date and refresh tax and VAT facts each quarter.

subs.name: E-E-A-T signals
subs.action: Add credentials, client proof and named authors on service pages.

subs.name: Unique assets
subs.action: Keep calculators current; add one new tool a month.

subs.name: Coverage
subs.action: Add structured data to pages without it.

subs.name: Validity and match with visible content
subs.action: Check structured data against visible content in Google's Rich Results Test.

subs.name: Entity links (sameAs, @id graph)
subs.action: Add LinkedIn, Google listing and directory profiles to the Organization sameAs.

subs.name: Brand name consistency
subs.action: Use one brand name, F&B Performance, on the site, listing and profiles.

subs.name: Address, phone, licence consistency
subs.action: Add the street and city to the structured-data address (it shows only the country) and show the trade licence number in the footer.

subs.name: Google Business Profile and Maps
subs.action: Complete the Google Business Profile: services, photos, weekly posts, booking link.

subs.name: sameAs and social profiles
subs.action: Link LinkedIn and other profiles to the site and back.

subs.name: Directory citations
subs.action: List the firm in UAE business, Zoho, Xero and QuickBooks advisor directories with identical details.

subs.name: Referring domains and backlinks
subs.action: Pitch one data piece (delivery commission take-home, SBR 2029) to Gulf News, Khaleej Times or Hospitality News ME.

subs.name: Brand mentions
subs.action: Get named in partner posts by POS and accounting software vendors.

subs.name: Off-site social proof
subs.action: Collect Google reviews and LinkedIn recommendations from the first clients.

subs.name: Answer-first passages
subs.action: Open each guide with a two-sentence direct answer.

subs.name: Quotable facts with sources and dates
subs.action: Put the source and date next to every figure.

subs.name: Entity clarity
subs.action: State who, where and for whom in the first lines of key pages.

subs.name: AI crawler access
subs.action: Allow AI crawlers in robots.txt.

subs.name: llms.txt and machine-readable summaries
subs.action: Publish llms.txt summarising services, prices and tools.

subs.name: Consistency of facts across pages
subs.action: Keep prices and service names identical across pages.

subs.name: Presence for the 17 target searches
subs.action: Strengthen the pages for target searches closest to showing.

subs.name: Cited by AI-style answers
subs.action: Publish short, dated answers to the top owner questions so AI assistants can cite and link them.

subs.name: Featured-snippet and PAA-shaped content
subs.action: Answer common questions in short question-and-answer blocks.

subs.name: hreflang correctness and reciprocity
subs.action: Fix hreflang pairs that do not point back.

subs.name: Arabic content parity
subs.action: Publish Arabic versions of the {en_only_pages} that have none, then lengthen the shortest Arabic service pages.

subs.name: Arabic metadata quality
subs.action: Write native Arabic titles and descriptions, not translations.

subs.name: Arabic search targeting
subs.action: Retarget the Arabic home, Dubai and services titles to 'محاسبة المطاعم' and 'محاسب مطاعم في دبي'.

subs.name: Search Console and Bing verification
subs.action: Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools.

subs.name: IndexNow and sitemap ping
subs.action: Serve the IndexNow key file at the site root so Bing picks up changes within hours.

subs.name: Analytics and conversion events
subs.action: Mark generate_lead as a key event and send one test request to confirm it is recorded.

stage_note: Stages are 7-day spans from the Nov 15 launch.
clusters_note: Topics an F&B owner in the UAE searches for. A page belongs to a topic when its title or H1 contains one of the words. Three pages per language is full coverage.
